controls.name: remove-frame-age
controls.test: an unchanged scene cannot admit a frame two minutes out of date

controls.name: remove-invalidation-epoch
controls.test: explicit invalidation fences a pending completion even when identity is reused

controls.name: ignore-wall-discontinuity
controls.test: wall-clock backward discontinuity is caught even without a timer poll

controls.name: allow-hidden-work
controls.test: hidden state refuses forced work and obsolete completions

controls.name: reuse-asset-attempt

controls.name: admit-obsolete-asset
controls.test: late A completion cannot replace B after retry

scope: Six isolated native lifecycle/asset negative controls; passing clean control paired with each deliberately broken variant. Candidate untouched.
